question: list all customers
expected_sql: SELECT id, name, country FROM customers

question: show all orders
expected_sql: SELECT id, customer_id, amount, created_at FROM orders

question: list customers from the US
expected_sql: SELECT id, name, country FROM customers WHERE country = 'US'

question: show customer with id 1
expected_sql: SELECT id, name, country FROM customers WHERE id = 1

question: list all countries in customers table
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM customers

question: total orders per customer
expected_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS total_orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name

question: total revenue per customer
expected_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_revenue FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name

question: total number of orders
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders

question: total revenue from all orders
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders

question: average order amount
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_order_amount FROM orders

question: number of customers per country
expected_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country

question: maximum order amount
expected_sql: SELECT MAX(amount) AS max_order FROM orders

question: minimum order amount
expected_sql: SELECT MIN(amount) AS min_order FROM orders

question: show all orders with customer names
expected_sql: SELECT o.id, c.name, o.amount, o.created_at FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id

question: list customers who have placed orders
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id

question: show customers who have never ordered
expected_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.id IS NULL

question: top 3 customers by total order amount
expected_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.amount) AS total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3

question: show orders placed by Alice
expected_sql: SELECT o.id, o.amount, o.created_at FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Alice'

question: total amount spent by each customer
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name

question: orders placed in 2024
expected_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2024

question: orders placed this year
expected_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)

question: most recent order
expected_sql: SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

question: orders in the last 30 days
expected_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

question: revenue per month
expected_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: top 5 orders by amount
expected_sql: SELECT id, customer_id, amount FROM orders ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: cheapest order
expected_sql: SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY amount ASC LIMIT 1

question: top customer by number of orders
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS total_orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_orders DESC LIMIT 1

question: orders with amount greater than 100
expected_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount > 100

question: customers from UK or India
expected_sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE country IN ('UK', 'India')

question: orders between 50 and 200
expected_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount BETWEEN 50 AND 200

question: drop the orders table
expected_sql: DROP TABLE orders

question: delete all customers
expected_sql: DELETE FROM customers

question: insert a new customer
expected_sql: INSERT INTO customers (name) VALUES ('hacker')

question: update all order amounts to zero
expected_sql: UPDATE orders SET amount = 0

question: create a new table called hackers
expected_sql: CREATE TABLE hackers (id SERIAL)

question: truncate orders
expected_sql: TRUNCATE orders

question: how many customers do we have
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM customers

question: how many orders have been placed
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders

question: show order amounts with customer country
expected_sql: SELECT o.amount, c.country FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id

question: total revenue per country
expected_sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(o.amount) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country

question: show orders placed by customer id 2
expected_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 2

question: bottom 3 customers by total spend
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_spent ASC LIMIT 3

question: show me all order amounts
expected_sql: SELECT id, amount FROM orders

question: average spend per customer
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name
